high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "english.elpais.com." The content of the article discusses a significant achievement by Gómez Serrano, a Spanish professor, in collaboration with Google DeepMind. Specifically, they have developed AlphaEvolve, a new artificial intelligence system designed to solve complex mathematical problems with unprecedented efficiency. The article highlights that Gómez Serrano and his American colleague Terence Tao (who is referred to as the greatest living mathematician) trained the program for four months using 50 puzzles.
